consequences: Developer timeline shows real waiting and phases. Process loss becomes end_unobserved. This additive plaintext metadata table is not an encrypted conversation artifact or a global worker/provider tracing solution; inactive stores are physically pruned on the next observation write.
context: Consumer delivery is not extraction completion; previous samples lacked per-job waiting and attempt evidence.
decision: Store bounded L0 execution attempts in the owning Memory database, scoped by owner agent conversation turn and correlation. Retain 7 days, prune on writes, filter on reads. Keep payloads and raw errors out; diagnostics fail open without changing canonical lease checkpoint Gate or retry semantics.
title: Scoped content-free Memory extraction attempts
